focus: correctness — default run storage path allocation

findingDetails.title: Default dated folders can overwrite same-day evidence
findingDetails.evidence: defaultOutputsDir() composes only date/subject/variant; run() calls fs.mkdirSync(outputsDir, { recursive: true }) with no occupancy guard before writing the report pair and five companions.
findingDetails.claim: The default path can overwrite an earlier same-day run with the same subject and variant.
findingDetails.recommendation: Allocate a unique trailing suffix or fail closed before writes; mirror the collision guard in archive-compiled-routing.cjs:167-169.
findingDetails.scopeProof: runFolderName() emits three fields; the owning grammar at create-benchmark/SKILL.md:312 and spec.md:181 require a same-day trailing disambiguator that the default writer does not emit.

results.summary: Same-day disambiguation is specified but absent from the default writer.
Playbook contract delegates default path selection to the affected writer.

noveltyJustification: First correctness pass established a data-preservation failure in the default writer, with a directly analogous collision guard already present in the archiver.
